title: Phase transition for a black hole with matter fields and the relation with the Lyapunov exponent
summary: We construct static black hole solutions coexisting with anisotropic matter in asymptotically (anti-)de Sitter spacetime and investigate how the matter field modifies their thermodynamic and dynamical properties. The anisotropic matter generates an exponentially decaying charge-like contribution to the metric, causing the geometry to interpolate between the Schwarzschild black hole in anti-de Sitter spacetime and the Reissner-Nordström black hole in anti-de Sitter spacetime.
